Rust crates compiled into the WebAssembly module that Spark 2.4.0 embeds
(@sparkjsdev/spark dist/spark.module.js), and therefore into
assets/spatial_viewer/viewer.bundle.js.

Method: the module's embedded source paths (panic locations) name every crate
listed below, with the exact version (checked again on 2026-11-23 by decoding
the module out of viewer.bundle.js; test/spatial_viewer_asset_contract.test.js
repeats the decoding on every run and fails when a crate name and version
found in the module is missing here). Each licence text below is the file the
crate's published source package carries for that exact version, copied
verbatim from the package downloaded from crates.io on 2026-11-22 (dlmalloc,
hashbrown 0.15.5 and rustc-demangle: 2026-11-23). The standard library's text is
LICENSE-MIT of the rust-lang/rust repository at the commit named in its section,
the commit the module's paths carry. The list is
a floor: a crate that carries no panic path would not appear in it. Spark's own
Rust code (rust/spark-lib, rust/spark-rs) is MIT, see SPARK-MIT.txt.

Every dual-licensed crate, and the Rust standard library (MIT OR Apache-2.0),
is used here under its MIT option (memchr: MIT rather than Unlicense). ruzstd,
serde-wasm-bindgen and zip are MIT only; zlib-rs is under the Zlib licence. The MIT licence requires the copyright
notice and the permission notice to travel with copies, so each crate's notice
follows. Where a crate's licence file names no holder, the holder line states
the author given in that crate's Cargo.toml. Nothing in the list is copyleft.

Index: anyhow, console_error_panic_hook, dlmalloc, fdeflate, flate2,
hashbrown (0.15.5 and 0.16.1), image, image-webp, indexmap, js-sys, memchr, png,
rustc-demangle, ruzstd, serde, serde_core, serde-wasm-bindgen, serde_json,
smallvec, wasm-bindgen, zip, zlib-rs, and the Rust standard library (core,
alloc, std; the last section).
